scope: Frozen source and existing compact telemetry only; root documentation phase c5fe
source_findings: Both frozen hosts already conditionally reevaluate only when SDRAM DQ changes after device.sample; skipping an unchanged third eval is not a new optimization.
Preserve both physical half-edge evals, the 10416/10417 ps timeInc sequence, guest CPU and clock-enable behavior, and physical SDRAM command servicing.

The CL2 pin model schedules at most one read per edge and completes due reads before new commands; the pending vector has at most two outstanding entries. Replacing it has no demonstrated performance benefit.
Audio observe executes after the real rising edge, but CSV emission is gated by audio_sample_ce or accepted sound writes.
Kyros HUD detailed processing is window gated; stack/register journaling is event gated. A large output file alone does not establish ongoing I/O dominance.
No source-only proof attributes CPU time among generated RTL eval, SDRAM servicing, observers and CSV formatting.

first_hit_1010.limit: Elapsed native run includes startup and terminal failure. It is not a successful fidelity or paired performance benchmark.

Kyros_durable_progress_snapshot.limit: Progress estimate based on a mutable stdout file's then-observed mtime, not terminal elapsed timing or current live status. Future dense observer windows and host contention can change throughput.

stat_only_output_snapshot.limit: File metadata only; no huge journal read or tail rehash. These sizes do not prove a dominant cost.

future_proposal_only.when: Next already-required host revision and native qualification; not the current live run
future_proposal_only.measure_first: Attribute eval, SDRAM, observer and formatting CPU/wall costs with external sampling or coarse host-only counters. Avoid a timing call on every guest edge.
future_proposal_only.candidate: If formatting is material, investigate reserved buffered CSV formatting while retaining identical rows, values, ordering and flush checkpoints.
future_proposal_only.acceptance: A future paired timing comparison and evidence equivalence must precede any speedup claim. Retain actual clock/timeInc/CE/physical memory/real CPU and every applicable graphics, RAM, protocol and audio gate.
future_proposal_only.risks: Instrumentation overhead, changed flush/recovery behavior, incomplete rows on failure, observer-state/generation loss and altered DQ settling. No semantic waiver or Process Lasso change is proposed.
